Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/16] The Personal Wellbeing Index (PWI) (Cummins et al., 2003; International Wellbeing Group, 2013) is a well-validated 7-item measure of SWB. [/page/3/Text/2] An overall measure of SWB is taken as the mean of these seven items. In the present sample, the PWI scale correlated highly with a single-item 0-10 measure of general life satisfaction (i.e., "How satisfied are you with your life as a whole?"); for example, the cross-sectional correlation for the first wave was r = .78. In addition, in one wave of the study, the commonly used 5-item Satisfaction with Life Scale (Diener, Emmons, Larsen, & Griffin, 1985) was administered; it also correlated highly with the PWI scale (r = .75, n = 696).
